title: Return Negative Number

examples.explanation: Zero does not change its sign identity.

title: Remainder of Division
description: Given two positive integers dividend and divisor, return the remainder when the dividend is divided by the divisor.

examples.explanation: 4 goes into 7 once, leaving a remainder of 3.

constraints.constraintText: divisor will always be greater than 0.
